post.title: Fake job offers cost people $501 million in 2024
post.ig:
Fake job offers cost people $501 million in 2024.

Reported job scam losses grew from $90 million in 2020 to $501 million in 2024 (FTC).
The common asks: pay for equipment, pay for training, or deposit money to unlock earnings.
The FTC: "Honest employers will never ask you to pay to get a job."

Sources: FTC Consumer Sentinel data (March 2025), FTC Data Spotlight (December 2024), FTC job scams guidance.
News and education, not financial advice.

post.yt_desc:
Job offer scams flip the money the wrong way: you pay for equipment, training, or a deposit to unlock earnings. FTC data show reported job scam losses grew from $90 million in 2020 to $501 million in 2024, and the FTC says honest employers will never ask you to pay to get a job. Sources: FTC (March 2025), FTC Data Spotlight (December 2024).

News and education, not financial advice.
